senses.gloss:
मोचः [मुच् अच्]
1 The plantain
tree.
--2 The tree called शोभांजन.
--चा
1 The plantain tree.
--2 The
cotton shrub.
--3 The indigo plant.
--चं A plantain fruit.

मोचक a. [मुच्-ण्वुल्]
1 Liberating,
freeing.
--2 Finally emancipated.
absolved.
--कः
1 A devotee, an
ascetic.
--2 Emancipation, deliverance.
--3 A plantain tree.
--4 The tree
called शोभांजन.

मोचन a. (नी f.) [मुच्-ल्यु ल्युट् वा]
Releasing, freeing from.
--नं
1
Releasing, liberating, setting free,
emancipating.
--2 Unyoking.
--3
Discharging, emitting.
--4 Acquittance
of a debt or obligation.
--5
Arrogance, pride.
--6 Deceit, fraud.
--Comp.
[]
--पट्टंकः a filter.

1 The pith or fruit of the
banana.
--2 Sandal wood.
--3 A kind
of pungent seed.
